title: Offline by Design: The Rise of Phone-Free Experiences in 2026's Analog Era
claim: Eventbrite's listing data shows phone-free events up 567% globally from 2024 to 2025, with US attendance up 913%.
excerpt: Summary (also carried by Mixmag): analyzed listings using 'phone-free'/'photo-free' terms for 2024, 2025 and Q1 2026; global events +567%, attendance +121%; US listings +337%, attendance +913%; 49% of Gen Z/millennials want live experiences to feel less curated.
